name: btn-bg-shine

frames.best_why: The whole button is in frame with its white hover border and the cursor sits far away at the bottom right.

tagline: Pale light sweeps across a wide blue button, looping end to end.
summary: A single large rounded button labelled Click Me, filled with a blue-violet gradient that slides continuously. Its thin outline turns bright white while the pointer is over it.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle in deep blue-violet holds a bold white label centred on it. A soft lighter band drifts diagonally across the fill, and a thin lavender outline sits at rest, becoming a thick white border on hover.
behaviour: The gradient background loops from edge to edge, so a pale sheen keeps travelling across the button. Hovering replaces the thin lavender outline with a bright white one that lifts the button off the dark stage.
search_phrases: blue button with moving light band
white border on hover blue button
call to action button with moving sheen
neon blue button for dark pages
use_when: A single primary action should stand out on a dark page without needing icons or extra layout.
avoid_when: The fill and label colours are fixed blue on white text, so it will not blend into an arbitrary brand palette.
customise: The label text, gradient stops and border colours are written into the class names, so changing them means editing the file; it takes no props.
weight_why: One button and one looping CSS gradient, with no JavaScript at all.

a11y.note: The visible label and a focus ring make it usable, but the looping sheen never pauses for reduced-motion users.

issues: The lighter band is faint, so the shine reads mostly as a flat blue fill in stills.
Frames 2 to 6 all catch the hover border, leaving only frame 1 for the resting state.
polish_why: Clean and functional, but it is an ordinary rounded button with one gradient sweep.
title: Background Shine Button
